correctness.rationale: Proof checks all finite-stage definitions; unmarked languages are exactly three ordinary full binary shifts plus three phase-labeled directed full shifts, with 6*2^n factors, and their reversal classes are exactly 9/2*2^n+3/2*2^ceil(n/2). For n>=2, length-n words meeting short marker runs number at most 8n(n-1), those meeting long runs at most 8(n-1)+1. Thus both error terms are polynomial or subexponential, proving ratio 3/4. Aperiodicity follows from arbitrarily long marker runs with infinitely many nonmarkers. Standalone checker reproduces n=2..9 formula checks; finite checks not mistaken for proof.
